(* -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
(* STEP 1: SAFETY INSTRUMENTED SYSTEM (SIS) & ESD MASTER TRIP EVALUATION                              *)

(* Hardwired Safety Interlock: Loss of SIS permissive or ESD actuation triggers immediate trip *)
IF (NOT bSafetyPermissive_SIS) OR (NOT bEmergencyStop_ESD) THEN
    bTripLatched := TRUE;
    bSynthesisLoopTripActive := TRUE;
    iOperationalState := 100; (* Force finite state machine to emergency depressurization *)

(* Operator Fault Reset Logic *)
IF bResetFaults AND bSafetyPermissive_SIS AND bEmergencyStop_ESD THEN
    IF iOperationalState = 100 THEN
        bTripLatched := FALSE;
        bSynthesisLoopTripActive := FALSE;
        iOperationalState := 0; (* Reset sequence back to safe depressurized idle *)
        bStateJustEntered := TRUE;
    ELSE
        bTripLatched := FALSE;
        bSynthesisLoopTripActive := FALSE;
    END_IF;
END_IF;

(* -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
(* STEP 2: 2oo3 TRIPLE MODULAR REDUNDANCY (TMR) SENSOR VOTING ENGINE                                  *)
(* -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
(* --- Synthesis Loop Pressure 2oo3 Evaluation (PT-101A, PT-101B, PT-101C) --- *)
rDiffPressure_AB := ABS(rLoopPressure_PT101A_bar - rLoopPressure_PT101B_bar);
rDiffPressure_BC := ABS(rLoopPressure_PT101B_bar - rLoopPressure_PT101C_bar);
rDiffPressure_CA := ABS(rLoopPressure_PT101C_bar - rLoopPressure_PT101A_bar);

tPressureDiscrep_AB(IN := (rDiffPressure_AB > 3.5), PT := T#2S);
tPressureDiscrep_BC(IN := (rDiffPressure_BC > 3.5), PT := T#2S);
tPressureDiscrep_CA(IN := (rDiffPressure_CA > 3.5), PT := T#2S);

(* Sensor Channel Invalidation on Sustained Paired Discrepancy *)
IF tPressureDiscrep_AB.Q AND tPressureDiscrep_CA.Q THEN
    bPressureChA_Valid := FALSE; (* PT-101A drifted relative to both B and C *)
END_IF;
IF tPressureDiscrep_AB.Q AND tPressureDiscrep_BC.Q THEN
    bPressureChB_Valid := FALSE; (* PT-101B drifted relative to both A and C *)
END_IF;
IF tPressureDiscrep_BC.Q AND tPressureDiscrep_CA.Q THEN
    bPressureChC_Valid := FALSE; (* PT-101C drifted relative to both A and B *)
END_IF;

iPressureValidSensorCount := 0;
IF bPressureChA_Valid THEN iPressureValidSensorCount := iPressureValidSensorCount + 1; END_IF;
IF bPressureChB_Valid THEN iPressureValidSensorCount := iPressureValidSensorCount + 1; END_IF;
IF bPressureChC_Valid THEN iPressureValidSensorCount := iPressureValidSensorCount + 1; END_IF;

(* Pressure Voting Logic: Median Selection or Graceful Fallback *)
IF iPressureValidSensorCount >= 3 THEN
    (* Nominal 2oo3 Median Voting *)
    IF (rLoopPressure_PT101A_bar >= rLoopPressure_PT101B_bar AND rLoopPressure_PT101A_bar <= rLoopPressure_PT101C_bar) OR
       (rLoopPressure_PT101A_bar <= rLoopPressure_PT101B_bar AND rLoopPressure_PT101A_bar >= rLoopPressure_PT101C_bar) THEN
        rVotedLoopPressure_bar := rLoopPressure_PT101A_bar;
    ELSIF (rLoopPressure_PT101B_bar >= rLoopPressure_PT101A_bar AND rLoopPressure_PT101B_bar <= rLoopPressure_PT101C_bar) OR
          (rLoopPressure_PT101B_bar <= rLoopPressure_PT101A_bar AND rLoopPressure_PT101B_bar >= rLoopPressure_PT101C_bar) THEN
        rVotedLoopPressure_bar := rLoopPressure_PT101B_bar;
    ELSE
        rVotedLoopPressure_bar := rLoopPressure_PT101C_bar;
    END_IF;
ELSIF iPressureValidSensorCount = 2 THEN
    (* Degraded 1oo2 Average Voting *)
    IF bPressureChA_Valid AND bPressureChB_Valid THEN
        rVotedLoopPressure_bar := (rLoopPressure_PT101A_bar + rLoopPressure_PT101B_bar) * 0.5;
    ELSIF bPressureChB_Valid AND bPressureChC_Valid THEN
        rVotedLoopPressure_bar := (rLoopPressure_PT101B_bar + rLoopPressure_PT101C_bar) * 0.5;
    ELSE
        rVotedLoopPressure_bar := (rLoopPressure_PT101A_bar + rLoopPressure_PT101C_bar) * 0.5;
    END_IF;
ELSIF iPressureValidSensorCount = 1 THEN
    (* Degraded 1oo1 Single Sensor Operation *)
    IF bPressureChA_Valid THEN
        rVotedLoopPressure_bar := rLoopPressure_PT101A_bar;
    ELSIF bPressureChB_Valid THEN
        rVotedLoopPressure_bar := rLoopPressure_PT101B_bar;
    ELSE
        rVotedLoopPressure_bar := rLoopPressure_PT101C_bar;
    END_IF;
ELSE
    (* Total Sensor Failure Fallback *)
    rVotedLoopPressure_bar := rFiltLoopPressure_bar;
    bTripLatched := TRUE;
END_IF;

(* --- Catalyst Bed 1 Temperature 2oo3 Evaluation (TE-201A, TE-201B, TE-201C) --- *)
rDiffBed1Temp_AB := ABS(rBed1Temp_TE201A_degC - rBed1Temp_TE201B_degC);
rDiffBed1Temp_BC := ABS(rBed1Temp_TE201B_degC - rBed1Temp_TE201C_degC);

tBed1TempDiscrep_AB(IN := (rDiffBed1Temp_AB > 8.0), PT := T#2S);
tBed1TempDiscrep_BC(IN := (rDiffBed1Temp_BC > 8.0), PT := T#2S);
tBed1TempDiscrep_CA(IN := (rDiffBed1Temp_CA > 8.0), PT := T#2S);

IF tBed1TempDiscrep_AB.Q AND tBed1TempDiscrep_CA.Q THEN bBed1TempChA_Valid := FALSE; END_IF;
IF tBed1TempDiscrep_AB.Q AND tBed1TempDiscrep_BC.Q THEN bBed1TempChB_Valid := FALSE; END_IF;
IF tBed1TempDiscrep_BC.Q AND tBed1TempDiscrep_CA.Q THEN bBed1TempChC_Valid := FALSE; END_IF;

IF iBed1TempValidSensorCount >= 3 THEN
    IF (rBed1Temp_TE201A_degC >= rBed1Temp_TE201B_degC AND rBed1Temp_TE201A_degC <= rBed1Temp_TE201C_degC) OR
       (rBed1Temp_TE201A_degC <= rBed1Temp_TE201B_degC AND rBed1Temp_TE201A_degC >= rBed1Temp_TE201C_degC) THEN

    ELSIF (rBed1Temp_TE201B_degC >= rBed1Temp_TE201A_degC AND rBed1Temp_TE201B_degC <= rBed1Temp_TE201C_degC) OR
          (rBed1Temp_TE201B_degC <= rBed1Temp_TE201A_degC AND rBed1Temp_TE201B_degC >= rBed1Temp_TE201C_degC) THEN
        rVotedBed1Temp_degC := rBed1Temp_TE201B_degC;

        rVotedBed1Temp_degC := rBed1Temp_TE201C_degC;
    END_IF;
ELSIF iBed1TempValidSensorCount = 2 THEN
    IF bBed1TempChA_Valid AND bBed1TempChB_Valid THEN
        rVotedBed1Temp_degC := (rBed1Temp_TE201A_degC + rBed1Temp_TE201B_degC) * 0.5;
    ELSIF bBed1TempChB_Valid AND bBed1TempChC_Valid THEN
        rVotedBed1Temp_degC := (rBed1Temp_TE201B_degC + rBed1Temp_TE201C_degC) * 0.5;
    ELSE
        rVotedBed1Temp_degC := (rBed1Temp_TE201A_degC + rBed1Temp_TE201C_degC) * 0.5;
    END_IF;
ELSIF iBed1TempValidSensorCount = 1 THEN
    IF bBed1TempChA_Valid THEN
        rVotedBed1Temp_degC := rBed1Temp_TE201A_degC;
    ELSIF bBed1TempChB_Valid THEN
        rVotedBed1Temp_degC := rBed1Temp_TE201B_degC;
    ELSE
        rVotedBed1Temp_degC := rBed1Temp_TE201C_degC;

ELSE

(* -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
(* STEP 3: DIGITAL FILTERING & DERIVATIVE / THERMAL GRADIENT CALCULATIONS                             *)

(* Exponential 1st-order low-pass filters: y_k = alpha*y_{k-1} + (1-alpha)*u_k *)
rFiltLoopPressure_bar     := (0.85 * rFiltLoopPressure_bar) + (0.15 * rVotedLoopPressure_bar);

rFiltH2_N2_Ratio          := (0.90 * rFiltH2_N2_Ratio) + (0.10 * rH2_N2_Ratio_AT401_molmol);
rFiltInertsFraction_pct  := (0.92 * rFiltInertsFraction_pct) + (0.08 * rInertsFraction_AT402_pct);
rFiltCondenserTemp_degC  := (0.85 * rFiltCondenserTemp_degC) + (0.15 * rCondenserTemp_TE501_degC);
rFiltRenewablePower_kW   := (0.75 * rFiltRenewablePower_kW) + (0.25 * rRenewablePowerAvailable_kW);
rFiltAmmoniaProd_kgh     := (0.85 * rFiltAmmoniaProd_kgh) + (0.15 * rAmmoniaProduction_FT701_kgh);

(* Discrete Derivative Estimation (Units: deg C/min and kW/s) *)
IF rCycleTime_s > 0.001 THEN
    rBed1RateOfChange_degC_min := ((rFiltBed1Temp_degC - rPrevBed1Temp_degC) / rCycleTime_s) * 60.0;
    rBed2RateOfChange_degC_min := ((rFiltBed2Temp_degC - rPrevBed2Temp_degC) / rCycleTime_s) * 60.0;
    rBed3RateOfChange_degC_min := ((rFiltBed3Temp_degC - rPrevBed3Temp_degC) / rCycleTime_s) * 60.0;
    rRenewablePowerRamp_kW_s   := (rFiltRenewablePower_kW - rPrevRenewablePower_kW) / rCycleTime_s;
END_IF;

rPrevBed1Temp_degC        := rFiltBed1Temp_degC;
rPrevBed2Temp_degC        := rFiltBed2Temp_degC;
rPrevBed3Temp_degC        := rFiltBed3Temp_degC;
rPrevRenewablePower_kW    := rFiltRenewablePower_kW;
rPrevFreshSyngasFlow_Nm3h := rFiltFreshSyngasFlow_Nm3h;
rPrevLoopPressure_bar     := rFiltLoopPressure_bar;

(* Multi-bed inter-bed spatial thermal gradients *)
rDeltaTemp_Bed1_Bed2 := rFiltBed1Temp_degC - rFiltBed2Temp_degC;
rDeltaTemp_Bed2_Bed3 := rFiltBed2Temp_degC - rFiltBed3Temp_degC;

(* -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
(* STEP 4: STATE-SPACE DISCRETE MODEL INITIALIZATION & OBSERVER UPDATE                               *)
(* -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
IF NOT bMatricesInitialized THEN
    (* State matrix A (6x6) discrete-time representation *)
    matA[0,0] := 0.942; matA[0,1] := 0.000; matA[0,2] := 0.000; matA[0,3] := 0.015; matA[0,4] := -0.008; matA[0,5] := 0.012;
    matA[1,0] := 0.052; matA[1,1] := 0.935; matA[1,2] := 0.000; matA[1,3] := 0.012; matA[1,4] := -0.006; matA[1,5] := 0.010;
    matA[2,0] := 0.008; matA[2,1] := 0.058; matA[2,2] := 0.928; matA[2,3] := 0.009; matA[2,4] := -0.005; matA[2,5] := 0.007;
    matA[3,0] := 0.004; matA[3,1] := 0.003; matA[3,2] := 0.002; matA[3,3] := 0.982; matA[3,4] := 0.000;  matA[3,5] := -0.004;
    matA[4,0] := 0.000; matA[4,1] := 0.000; matA[4,2] := 0.000; matA[4,3] := 0.001; matA[4,4] := 0.995;  matA[4,5] := 0.000;
    matA[5,0] := 0.000; matA[5,1] := 0.000; matA[5,2] := 0.000; matA[5,3] := 0.000; matA[5,4] := 0.000;  matA[5,5] := 0.965;

    (* Input matrix B (6x4) *)
    matB[0,0] := -0.185; matB[0,1] :=  0.000; matB[0,2] := 0.005; matB[0,3] := -0.002;
    matB[1,0] := -0.042; matB[1,1] := -0.192; matB[1,2] := 0.004; matB[1,3] := -0.002;
    matB[2,0] := -0.011; matB[2,1] := -0.045; matB[2,2] := 0.003; matB[2,3] := -0.001;
    matB[3,0] :=  0.002; matB[3,1] :=  0.002; matB[3,2] := 0.028; matB[3,3] := -0.045;
    matB[4,0] :=  0.000; matB[4,1] :=  0.000; matB[4,2] := 0.000; matB[4,3] := -0.038;
    matB[5,0] :=  0.000; matB[5,1] :=  0.000; matB[5,2] := 0.082; matB[5,3] :=  0.004;

    (* Disturbance matrix E (6x2) *)
    matE[0,0] := 0.00008; matE[0,1] :=  0.00012;
    matE[1,0] := 0.00006; matE[1,1] :=  0.00010;
    matE[2,0] := 0.00004; matE[2,1] :=  0.00008;
    matE[3,0] := 0.00015; matE[3,1] :=  0.00045;
    matE[4,0] := 0.00000; matE[4,1] := -0.00005;
    matE[5,0] :=-0.00004; matE[5,1] :=  0.00001;

    (* Luenberger Observer Gain Matrix L (6x6) *)
    matL_Obs[0,0] := 0.25; matL_Obs[1,1] := 0.22; matL_Obs[2,2] := 0.20;
    matL_Obs[3,3] := 0.30; matL_Obs[4,4] := 0.15; matL_Obs[5,5] := 0.28;

    (* MPC Diagonal Weight Matrices *)
    vecQ_diag[0] := 4.0; vecQ_diag[1] := 3.5; vecQ_diag[2] := 3.0;
    vecQ_diag[3] := 2.5; vecQ_diag[4] := 1.8; vecQ_diag[5] := 5.0;
    vecR_diag[0] := 1.2; vecR_diag[1] := 1.2; vecR_diag[2] := 1.5; vecR_diag[3] := 0.8;
    vecS_diag[0] := 2.0; vecS_diag[1] := 2.0; vecS_diag[2] := 2.5; vecS_diag[3] := 1.5;

    (* Actuator Box Limits [%] *)
    vecU_min[0] := 0.0;   vecU_max[0] := 100.0; vecDeltaU_max[0] := 2.5;
    vecU_min[1] := 0.0;   vecU_max[1] := 100.0; vecDeltaU_max[1] := 2.5;
    vecU_min[2] := 0.0;   vecU_max[2] := 100.0; vecDeltaU_max[2] := 3.0;
    vecU_min[3] := 0.0;   vecU_max[3] := 100.0; vecDeltaU_max[3] := 4.0;

    bMatricesInitialized := TRUE;
END_IF;

(* Compute current state deviation vector x relative to baseload operating point *)
vecX[0] := rFiltBed1Temp_degC - 450.0;      (* Bed 1 deviation from 450 deg C *)
vecX[1] := rFiltBed2Temp_degC - 440.0;      (* Bed 2 deviation from 440 deg C *)
vecX[2] := rFiltBed3Temp_degC - 430.0;      (* Bed 3 deviation from 430 deg C *)
vecX[3] := rFiltLoopPressure_bar - 150.0;   (* Loop pressure deviation from 150 bar *)
vecX[4] := rFiltInertsFraction_pct - 8.0;   (* Inerts fraction deviation from 8.0 % *)
vecX[5] := rFiltH2_N2_Ratio - 3.000;        (* Stoichiometric ratio deviation from 3.000 *)

(* Disturbance vector *)
vecDisturb[0] := rFiltRenewablePower_kW - 25000.0;
vecDisturb[1] := rFiltFreshSyngasFlow_Nm3h - 30000.0;

(* Forward one-step State Observer Prediction: x_{k+1} = A*x + B*u + E*d *)
vecX_pred[0] := (matA[0,0]*vecX[0] + matA[0,1]*vecX[1] + matA[0,2]*vecX[2] + matA[0,3]*vecX[3] + matA[0,4]*vecX[4] + matA[0,5]*vecX[5])
               + (matB[0,0]*vecU[0] + matB[0,1]*vecU[1] + matB[0,2]*vecU[2] + matB[0,3]*vecU[3])
               + (matE[0,0]*vecDisturb[0] + matE[0,1]*vecDisturb[1]);

vecX_pred[1] := (matA[1,0]*vecX[0] + matA[1,1]*vecX[1] + matA[1,2]*vecX[2] + matA[1,3]*vecX[3] + matA[1,4]*vecX[4] + matA[1,5]*vecX[5])
               + (matB[1,0]*vecU[0] + matB[1,1]*vecU[1] + matB[1,2]*vecU[2] + matB[1,3]*vecU[3])
               + (matE[1,0]*vecDisturb[0] + matE[1,1]*vecDisturb[1]);

vecX_pred[2] := (matA[2,0]*vecX[0] + matA[2,1]*vecX[1] + matA[2,2]*vecX[2] + matA[2,3]*vecX[3] + matA[2,4]*vecX[4] + matA[2,5]*vecX[5])
               + (matB[2,0]*vecU[0] + matB[2,1]*vecU[1] + matB[2,2]*vecU[2] + matB[2,3]*vecU[3])
               + (matE[2,0]*vecDisturb[0] + matE[2,1]*vecDisturb[1]);

vecX_pred[3] := (matA[3,0]*vecX[0] + matA[3,1]*vecX[1] + matA[3,2]*vecX[2] + matA[3,3]*vecX[3] + matA[3,4]*vecX[4] + matA[3,5]*vecX[5])
               + (matB[3,0]*vecU[0] + matB[3,1]*vecU[1] + matB[3,2]*vecU[2] + matB[3,3]*vecU[3])
               + (matE[3,0]*vecDisturb[0] + matE[3,1]*vecDisturb[1]);

vecX_pred[4] := (matA[4,0]*vecX[0] + matA[4,1]*vecX[1] + matA[4,2]*vecX[2] + matA[4,3]*vecX[3] + matA[4,4]*vecX[4] + matA[4,5]*vecX[5])
               + (matB[4,0]*vecU[0] + matB[4,1]*vecU[1] + matB[4,2]*vecU[2] + matB[4,3]*vecU[3])
               + (matE[4,0]*vecDisturb[0] + matE[4,1]*vecDisturb[1]);

vecX_pred[5] := (matA[5,0]*vecX[0] + matA[5,1]*vecX[1] + matA[5,2]*vecX[2] + matA[5,3]*vecX[3] + matA[5,4]*vecX[4] + matA[5,5]*vecX[5])
               + (matB[5,0]*vecU[0] + matB[5,1]*vecU[1] + matB[5,2]*vecU[2] + matB[5,3]*vecU[3])
               + (matE[5,0]*vecDisturb[0] + matE[5,1]*vecDisturb[1]);

(* Luenberger observer correction step: x_hat = x_pred + L*(x - x_pred) *)
vecX_hat[0] := vecX_pred[0] + (matL_Obs[0,0] * (vecX[0] - vecX_pred[0]));
vecX_hat[1] := vecX_pred[1] + (matL_Obs[1,1] * (vecX[1] - vecX_pred[1]));
vecX_hat[2] := vecX_pred[2] + (matL_Obs[2,2] * (vecX[2] - vecX_pred[2]));
vecX_hat[3] := vecX_pred[3] + (matL_Obs[3,3] * (vecX[3] - vecX_pred[3]));
vecX_hat[4] := vecX_pred[4] + (matL_Obs[4,4] * (vecX[4] - vecX_pred[4]));
vecX_hat[5] := vecX_pred[5] + (matL_Obs[5,5] * (vecX[5] - vecX_pred[5]));

(* Estimated Peak Core Hotspot in Catalyst Bed 1 (incorporates thermal wave front) *)
rPredictedBed1MaxTemp_degC := 450.0 + vecX_hat[0] + (0.55 * rBed1RateOfChange_degC_min);

(* -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
(* STEP 5: RECEDING HORIZON MPC QUADRATIC COST ACTIVE-SET SOLVER                                     *)
(* -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
(* Diagonal Approximate Hessian Formulation *)
vecHessianDiag[0] := 2.0 * ((matB[0,0]*matB[0,0]*vecQ_diag[0]) + (matB[1,0]*matB[1,0]*vecQ_diag[1]) + (matB[2,0]*matB[2,0]*vecQ_diag[2]) + (matB[3,0]*matB[3,0]*vecQ_diag[3]) + vecR_diag[0] + vecS_diag[0]);
vecHessianDiag[1] := 2.0 * ((matB[0,1]*matB[0,1]*vecQ_diag[0]) + (matB[1,1]*matB[1,1]*vecQ_diag[1]) + (matB[2,1]*matB[2,1]*vecQ_diag[2]) + (matB[3,1]*matB[3,1]*vecQ_diag[3]) + vecR_diag[1] + vecS_diag[1]);
vecHessianDiag[2] := 2.0 * ((matB[0,2]*matB[0,2]*vecQ_diag[0]) + (matB[3,2]*matB[3,2]*vecQ_diag[3]) + (matB[5,2]*matB[5,2]*vecQ_diag[5]) + vecR_diag[2] + vecS_diag[2]);
vecHessianDiag[3] := 2.0 * ((matB[3,3]*matB[3,3]*vecQ_diag[3]) + (matB[4,3]*matB[4,3]*vecQ_diag[4]) + vecR_diag[3] + vecS_diag[3]);

(* Iterative Projected Gradient Descent Solver Loop *)
FOR iMPCIteration := 1 TO iMPCMaxIterations DO
    (* Gradient computation *)
    vecGradient[0] := 2.0 * (matB[0,0]*vecQ_diag[0]*(vecX_hat[0] - vecX_ref[0]) + matB[1,0]*vecQ_diag[1]*(vecX_hat[1] - vecX_ref[1]) + matB[2,0]*vecQ_diag[2]*(vecX_hat[2] - vecX_ref[2]) + matB[3,0]*vecQ_diag[3]*(vecX_hat[3] - vecX_ref[3])) + 2.0*vecR_diag[0]*(vecU[0] - vecU_ref[0]) + 2.0*vecS_diag[0]*(vecU[0] - vecU_prev[0]);
    vecGradient[1] := 2.0 * (matB[1,1]*vecQ_diag[1]*(vecX_hat[1] - vecX_ref[1]) + matB[2,1]*vecQ_diag[2]*(vecX_hat[2] - vecX_ref[2])) + 2.0*vecR_diag[1]*(vecU[1] - vecU_ref[1]) + 2.0*vecS_diag[1]*(vecU[1] - vecU_prev[1]);
    vecGradient[2] := 2.0 * (matB[3,2]*vecQ_diag[3]*(vecX_hat[3] - vecX_ref[3]) + matB[5,2]*vecQ_diag[5]*(vecX_hat[5] - vecX_ref[5])) + 2.0*vecR_diag[2]*(vecU[2] - vecU_ref[2]) + 2.0*vecS_diag[2]*(vecU[2] - vecU_prev[2]);
    vecGradient[3] := 2.0 * (matB[3,3]*vecQ_diag[3]*(vecX_hat[3] - vecX_ref[3]) + matB[4,3]*vecQ_diag[4]*(vecX_hat[4] - vecX_ref[4])) + 2.0*vecR_diag[3]*(vecU[3] - vecU_ref[3]) + 2.0*vecS_diag[3]*(vecU[3] - vecU_prev[3]);

    (* Projected update *)
    IF vecHessianDiag[0] > 0.001 THEN vecU[0] := vecU[0] - (rMPC_StepSize * (vecGradient[0] / vecHessianDiag[0])); END_IF;
    IF vecHessianDiag[1] > 0.001 THEN vecU[1] := vecU[1] - (rMPC_StepSize * (vecGradient[1] / vecHessianDiag[1])); END_IF;
    IF vecHessianDiag[2] > 0.001 THEN vecU[2] := vecU[2] - (rMPC_StepSize * (vecGradient[2] / vecHessianDiag[2])); END_IF;
    IF vecHessianDiag[3] > 0.001 THEN vecU[3] := vecU[3] - (rMPC_StepSize * (vecGradient[3] / vecHessianDiag[3])); END_IF;

    (* Box constraints clamping *)
    IF vecU[0] < vecU_min[0] THEN vecU[0] := vecU_min[0]; ELSIF vecU[0] > vecU_max[0] THEN vecU[0] := vecU_max[0]; END_IF;
    IF vecU[1] < vecU_min[1] THEN vecU[1] := vecU_min[1]; ELSIF vecU[1] > vecU_max[1] THEN vecU[1] := vecU_max[1]; END_IF;
    IF vecU[2] < vecU_min[2] THEN vecU[2] := vecU_min[2]; ELSIF vecU[2] > vecU_max[2] THEN vecU[2] := vecU_max[2]; END_IF;
    IF vecU[3] < vecU_min[3] THEN vecU[3] := vecU_min[3]; ELSIF vecU[3] > vecU_max[3] THEN vecU[3] := vecU_max[3]; END_IF;
END_FOR;

(* Slew rate limiter on actuator moves *)
IF (vecU[0] - vecU_prev[0]) > vecDeltaU_max[0] THEN vecU[0] := vecU_prev[0] + vecDeltaU_max[0];
ELSIF (vecU[0] - vecU_prev[0]) < -vecDeltaU_max[0] THEN vecU[0] := vecU_prev[0] - vecDeltaU_max[0]; END_IF;

IF (vecU[1] - vecU_prev[1]) > vecDeltaU_max[1] THEN vecU[1] := vecU_prev[1] + vecDeltaU_max[1];
ELSIF (vecU[1] - vecU_prev[1]) < -vecDeltaU_max[1] THEN vecU[1] := vecU_prev[1] - vecDeltaU_max[1]; END_IF;

IF (vecU[2] - vecU_prev[2]) > vecDeltaU_max[2] THEN vecU[2] := vecU_prev[2] + vecDeltaU_max[2];
ELSIF (vecU[2] - vecU_prev[2]) < -vecDeltaU_max[2] THEN vecU[2] := vecU_prev[2] - vecDeltaU_max[2]; END_IF;

IF (vecU[3] - vecU_prev[3]) > vecDeltaU_max[3] THEN vecU[3] := vecU_prev[3] + vecDeltaU_max[3];
ELSIF (vecU[3] - vecU_prev[3]) < -vecDeltaU_max[3] THEN vecU[3] := vecU_prev[3] - vecDeltaU_max[3]; END_IF;

vecU_prev[0] := vecU[0];
vecU_prev[1] := vecU[1];
vecU_prev[2] := vecU[2];
vecU_prev[3] := vecU[3];

(* -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
(* STEP 6: CATALYST BED THERMAL GRADIENT SMOOTHING & QUENCH REGULATION                               *)
(* -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
(* Dynamic feedforward quench split calculation *)
rQuench1Trim_pct := (rQuenchGain_TempDev * (rFiltBed1Temp_degC - 450.0))
                    + (rQuenchGain_RateOfChange * rBed1RateOfChange_degC_min)
                    - (rQuenchGain_PowerRamp * rRenewablePowerRamp_kW_s);

rQuench2Trim_pct := (rQuenchGain_TempDev * 0.85 * (rFiltBed2Temp_degC - 440.0))
                    + (rQuenchGain_RateOfChange * 0.90 * rBed2RateOfChange_degC_min);

(* Inter-bed thermal stress gradient limiter overrides *)
IF rDeltaTemp_Bed1_Bed2 > 35.0 THEN
    rQuench1Trim_pct := rQuench1Trim_pct + (1.2 * (rDeltaTemp_Bed1_Bed2 - 35.0));
END_IF;
IF rDeltaTemp_Bed2_Bed3 > 25.0 THEN
    rQuench2Trim_pct := rQuench2Trim_pct + (1.2 * (rDeltaTemp_Bed2_Bed3 - 25.0));
END_IF;

(* Synthesize final valve demand *)
rQuenchBed1Valve_pct := rBaseQuench1_pct + vecU[0] + rQuench1Trim_pct;
rQuenchBed2Valve_pct := rBaseQuench2_pct + vecU[1] + rQuench2Trim_pct;

(* Clamp Actuator Demands 0.0% to 100.0% *)
IF rQuenchBed1Valve_pct < 0.0 THEN rQuenchBed1Valve_pct := 0.0; ELSIF rQuenchBed1Valve_pct > 100.0 THEN rQuenchBed1Valve_pct := 100.0; END_IF;
IF rQuenchBed2Valve_pct < 0.0 THEN rQuenchBed2Valve_pct := 0.0; ELSIF rQuenchBed2Valve_pct > 100.0 THEN rQuenchBed2Valve_pct := 100.0; END_IF;

(* Van Heerden Autothermal Stability Evaluation *)
rHeatGenerationRate_kW := (rFiltAmmoniaProd_kgh / 17.031) * 46.22 * 0.2778; (* Convert kmol*kJ/mol to kW *)
rHeatRemovalRate_kW    := (rFiltFreshSyngasFlow_Nm3h * 0.0298 * 1.05 * (rFiltBed1Temp_degC - 280.0) / 3600.0) + (rQuenchBed1Valve_pct * 85.0);
IF rHeatRemovalRate_kW > 1.0 THEN
    rVanHeerdenStabilityMargin_pct := ((rHeatRemovalRate_kW - rHeatGenerationRate_kW) / rHeatRemovalRate_kW) * 100.0;
ELSE
    rVanHeerdenStabilityMargin_pct := 50.0;
END_IF;

(* -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
(* STEP 7: CRYOGENIC CONDENSATION REFRIGERATION DECOUPLING COMPENSATOR                                *)
(* -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
(* Decoupling compensator canceling fresh syngas feed fluctuations and ammonia condensation loads *)
rBaseRefrigSpeed_rpm := 2400.0 + (rDecoupleGain_SyngasFlow * (rFiltFreshSyngasFlow_Nm3h - 30000.0))
                               + (rDecoupleGain_AmmoniaYield * (rFiltAmmoniaProd_kgh - 12500.0))
                               + (rDecoupleGain_PressureSwing * (rFiltLoopPressure_bar - 150.0));

(* PI feedback loop regulating condenser exit vapor temperature to setpoint (-18.0 deg C) *)
rChillerIntegralAccumulator := rChillerIntegralAccumulator + (rChillerIntegGain * (rFiltCondenserTemp_degC - rTargetCondenserTemp_degC) * rCycleTime_s);
IF rChillerIntegralAccumulator > 600.0 THEN rChillerIntegralAccumulator := 600.0; ELSIF rChillerIntegralAccumulator < -600.0 THEN rChillerIntegralAccumulator := -600.0; END_IF;

rChillerRefrigSpeed_rpm := rBaseRefrigSpeed_rpm + (rChillerPropGain * (rFiltCondenserTemp_degC - rTargetCondenserTemp_degC)) + rChillerIntegralAccumulator;

(* Cryogenic Freeze Protection Interlock (-32.0 deg C) *)
IF rFiltCondenserTemp_degC < -32.0 THEN
    rChillerRefrigSpeed_rpm := rMinChillerSpeed_rpm; (* Shed refrigeration to avert ammonia freezing *)
ELSIF rChillerRefrigSpeed_rpm > rMaxChillerSpeed_rpm THEN
    rChillerRefrigSpeed_rpm := rMaxChillerSpeed_rpm;
ELSIF rChillerRefrigSpeed_rpm < rMinChillerSpeed_rpm THEN
    rChillerRefrigSpeed_rpm := rMinChillerSpeed_rpm;
END_IF;

(* -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
(* STEP 8: PURGE GAS MEMBRANE HYDROGEN RECOVERY & INERTS REGULATOR                                   *)
(* -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
(* Fickian Permeation Balance: dynamic purge flow setpoint scales to loop inerts buildup *)
rCalculatedPurgeSP_Nm3h := rBasePurgeFlow_Nm3h * (1.0 + (0.18 * (rFiltInertsFraction_pct - rTargetInertsFraction_pct)));
IF rCalculatedPurgeSP_Nm3h < 300.0 THEN rCalculatedPurgeSP_Nm3h := 300.0; ELSIF rCalculatedPurgeSP_Nm3h > 2500.0 THEN rCalculatedPurgeSP_Nm3h := 2500.0; END_IF;

rPurgeControlIntegralAccum := rPurgeControlIntegralAccum + (0.012 * (rCalculatedPurgeSP_Nm3h - rMembranePurgeFlow_FT601_Nm3h) * rCycleTime_s);
IF rPurgeControlIntegralAccum > 30.0 THEN rPurgeControlIntegralAccum := 30.0; ELSIF rPurgeControlIntegralAccum < -30.0 THEN rPurgeControlIntegralAccum := -30.0; END_IF;

rMembranePurgeValve_pct := 35.0 + vecU[3] + (0.028 * (rCalculatedPurgeSP_Nm3h - rMembranePurgeFlow_FT601_Nm3h)) + rPurgeControlIntegralAccum;
IF rMembranePurgeValve_pct < 0.0 THEN rMembranePurgeValve_pct := 0.0; ELSIF rMembranePurgeValve_pct > 100.0 THEN rMembranePurgeValve_pct := 100.0; END_IF;

(* Membrane Hydrogen Permeation Efficiency Calculation [%] *)
IF rMembranePurgeFlow_FT601_Nm3h > 50.0 THEN
    rOptimalH2RecoveryRatio_pct := 92.5 + (0.045 * (rVotedLoopPressure_bar - 150.0)) - (0.35 * (rFiltInertsFraction_pct - 8.0));
    IF rOptimalH2RecoveryRatio_pct > 98.5 THEN rOptimalH2RecoveryRatio_pct := 98.5; ELSIF rOptimalH2RecoveryRatio_pct < 80.0 THEN rOptimalH2RecoveryRatio_pct := 80.0; END_IF;
ELSE
    rOptimalH2RecoveryRatio_pct := 0.0;
END_IF;

(* -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
(* STEP 9: SYNGAS STOICHIOMETRY (H2:N2 = 3:1) FEEDFORWARD / FEEDBACK TRIM                             *)
(* -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
rRatioError := rTargetStoichRatio - rFiltH2_N2_Ratio;
rRatioIntegralAccumulator := rRatioIntegralAccumulator + (rRatioIntegGain * rRatioError * rCycleTime_s);
IF rRatioIntegralAccumulator > 25.0 THEN rRatioIntegralAccumulator := 25.0; ELSIF rRatioIntegralAccumulator < -25.0 THEN rRatioIntegralAccumulator := -25.0; END_IF;

(* Combined Proportional, Integral & Renewable Derivative Feedforward Trim *)
rSyngasH2TrimValve_pct := 50.0 + vecU[2] + (rRatioPropGain * rRatioError) + rRatioIntegralAccumulator - (rRatioFeedforwardGain * rRenewablePowerRamp_kW_s);
IF rSyngasH2TrimValve_pct < 0.0 THEN rSyngasH2TrimValve_pct := 0.0; ELSIF rSyngasH2TrimValve_pct > 100.0 THEN rSyngasH2TrimValve_pct := 100.0; END_IF;

(* Recycle Compressor Aerodynamic Surge Margin Computation *)
rActualRecycleFlow_m3h := (rCirculationCompSpeed_rpm / 8200.0) * 45000.0;
rRecycleSurgeLimitFlow_m3h := 24000.0 + (0.05 * rCirculationCompSpeed_rpm);
IF rRecycleSurgeLimitFlow_m3h > 100.0 THEN
    rCompressorSurgeMargin_pct := ((rActualRecycleFlow_m3h - rRecycleSurgeLimitFlow_m3h) / rRecycleSurgeLimitFlow_m3h) * 100.0;
ELSE
    rCompressorSurgeMargin_pct := 30.0;
END_IF;

(* -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
(* STEP 10: MULTI-STAGE FINITE STATE MACHINE (11 OPERATIONAL MODES)                                   *)
(* -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
tStateDwellTimer(IN := NOT bStateJustEntered, PT := T#24H);

CASE iOperationalState OF
    0: (* STATE 0: IDLE_SAFE_DEPRESSURIZED *)
        rSyngasH2TrimValve_pct    := 0.0;
        rQuenchBed1Valve_pct      := 0.0;
        rQuenchBed2Valve_pct      := 0.0;
        rChillerRefrigSpeed_rpm   := 0.0;
        rMembranePurgeValve_pct   := 0.0;
        rCirculationCompSpeed_rpm := 0.0;
        rElectricPreheaterDuty_kW := 0.0;
        
        IF bOperatorStartCommand AND bSafetyPermissive_SIS AND (NOT bTripLatched) THEN
            iOperationalState := 10; (* Transition to inert purge *)
            bStateJustEntered := TRUE;
        END_IF;

    10: (* STATE 10: INERT_N2_SWEEP_PRESSURIZATION *)
        rCirculationCompSpeed_rpm := 2500.0; (* Slow circulation under pure N2 at 30 bar *)
        rElectricPreheaterDuty_kW := 150.0;  (* System dehydration warmup *)
        rMembranePurgeValve_pct   := 15.0;   (* Inert venting to scrubber *)
        
        tPurgeTimer(IN := TRUE, PT := T#30M);
        IF tPurgeTimer.Q AND (rVotedLoopPressure_bar >= 28.0) THEN
            tPurgeTimer(IN := FALSE);
            iOperationalState := 20; (* Proceed to catalyst reduction / preheat *)
            bStateJustEntered := TRUE;
        END_IF;

    20: (* STATE 20: CATALYST_PREHEAT_REDUCTION *)
        rCirculationCompSpeed_rpm := 4500.0;
        rElectricPreheaterDuty_kW := 1200.0; (* Controlled ramp to 380 deg C *)
        rQuenchBed1Valve_pct      := 5.0;
        rQuenchBed2Valve_pct      := 5.0;
        
        tPreheatTimer(IN := TRUE, PT := T#45M);
        IF (rVotedBed1Temp_degC >= 385.0) AND tPreheatTimer.Q THEN
            tPreheatTimer(IN := FALSE);
            iOperationalState := 30; (* Ready for reaction light-off *)
            bStateJustEntered := TRUE;
        END_IF;

    30: (* STATE 30: SYNTHESIS_LIGHTOFF_AUTOTHERMAL *)
        rElectricPreheaterDuty_kW := 400.0; (* Taper preheater as reaction exotherm ignites *)
        rCirculationCompSpeed_rpm := 6500.0;
        rChillerRefrigSpeed_rpm   := 1600.0;
        
        IF (rVotedBed1Temp_degC >= 420.0) AND (rAmmoniaProduction_FT701_kgh > 3000.0) THEN
            rElectricPreheaterDuty_kW := 0.0; (* Completely autothermal *)
            iOperationalState := 40; (* Nominal baseload reached *)
            bStateJustEntered := TRUE;
        END_IF;

    40: (* STATE 40: BASELOAD_STABILIZED_OPERATION (150 bar, 450 deg C) *)
        rElectricPreheaterDuty_kW := 0.0;
        rCirculationCompSpeed_rpm := 8200.0;
        
        IF ABS(rRenewablePowerRamp_kW_s) > 15.0 OR ABS(rFiltRenewablePower_kW - 25000.0) > 3000.0 THEN
            iOperationalState := 50; (* Transition to variable renewable tracking *)
            bStateJustEntered := TRUE;
        END_IF;
        IF bOperatorStopCommand THEN
            iOperationalState := 90; (* Orderly controlled turndown *)
            bStateJustEntered := TRUE;
        END_IF;

    50: (* STATE 50: DYNAMIC_RENEWABLE_POWER_TRACKING (30% - 110% LOAD) *)
        (* Synchronize recycle compressor speed with renewable power availability *)
        rCirculationCompSpeed_rpm := 5500.0 + ((rFiltRenewablePower_kW / 30000.0) * 3200.0);
        IF rCirculationCompSpeed_rpm > 9000.0 THEN rCirculationCompSpeed_rpm := 9000.0; ELSIF rCirculationCompSpeed_rpm < 5200.0 THEN rCirculationCompSpeed_rpm := 5200.0; END_IF;
        
        (* Sub-state priority transitions *)
        IF (ABS(rBed1RateOfChange_degC_min) > rMaxGradientAllowed_degC_min) OR (rDeltaTemp_Bed1_Bed2 > 35.0) THEN
            iOperationalState := 60; (* Priority thermal smoothing *)
            bStateJustEntered := TRUE;
        ELSIF rFiltInertsFraction_pct > 11.5 THEN
            iOperationalState := 70; (* Priority purge optimization *)
            bStateJustEntered := TRUE;
        ELSIF (rFiltCondenserTemp_degC > 0.0) OR (rFiltCondenserTemp_degC < -28.0) THEN
            iOperationalState := 80; (* Cryogenic decoupling load shed *)
            bStateJustEntered := TRUE;
        ELSIF rFiltRenewablePower_kW < 7500.0 THEN
            iOperationalState := 90; (* Controlled hot-idle turndown *)
            bStateJustEntered := TRUE;
        END_IF;

    60: (* STATE 60: THERMAL_GRADIENT_SMOOTHING_QUENCH *)
        (* Quench injection override to suppress propagating thermal waves *)
        IF rBed1RateOfChange_degC_min > 0.0 THEN
            rQuenchBed1Valve_pct := rQuenchBed1Valve_pct + 12.0;
        ELSE
            rQuenchBed1Valve_pct := rQuenchBed1Valve_pct - 8.0;
        END_IF;
        
        tThermalSoakTimer(IN := (ABS(rBed1RateOfChange_degC_min) <= 0.65), PT := T#5M);
        IF tThermalSoakTimer.Q THEN
            tThermalSoakTimer(IN := FALSE);
            iOperationalState := 50; (* Return to dynamic tracking *)
            bStateJustEntered := TRUE;
        END_IF;

    70: (* STATE 70: MEMBRANE_PURGE_STOICHIOMETRY_OPT *)
        rMembranePurgeValve_pct := rMembranePurgeValve_pct + 15.0;
        IF rMembranePurgeValve_pct > 95.0 THEN rMembranePurgeValve_pct := 95.0; END_IF;
        
        IF (rFiltInertsFraction_pct <= 8.2) AND (ABS(rFiltH2_N2_Ratio - 3.000) <= 0.035) THEN
            iOperationalState := 50;
            bStateJustEntered := TRUE;
        END_IF;

    80: (* STATE 80: CRYOGENIC_CONDENSER_LOAD_SHED *)
        IF rFiltCondenserTemp_degC > 0.0 THEN
            rChillerRefrigSpeed_rpm := rMaxChillerSpeed_rpm;
        ELSIF rFiltCondenserTemp_degC < -28.0 THEN
            rChillerRefrigSpeed_rpm := rMinChillerSpeed_rpm;
        END_IF;
        
        IF (rFiltCondenserTemp_degC >= -20.0) AND (rFiltCondenserTemp_degC <= -12.0) THEN
            iOperationalState := 50;
            bStateJustEntered := TRUE;
        END_IF;

    90: (* STATE 90: CONTROLLED_HOT_IDLE_TURNDOWN *)
        rCirculationCompSpeed_rpm := 4200.0; (* Minimum autothermal circulation *)
        rElectricPreheaterDuty_kW := 350.0;  (* Electric trim keeps Bed 1 above 390 deg C *)
        rQuenchBed1Valve_pct      := 2.0;
        rQuenchBed2Valve_pct      := 2.0;
        rChillerRefrigSpeed_rpm   := 1400.0;
        
        IF rFiltRenewablePower_kW > 12000.0 THEN
            iOperationalState := 50; (* Resume dynamic load following *)
            bStateJustEntered := TRUE;
        ELSIF bOperatorStopCommand THEN
            iOperationalState := 100; (* Proceed to shutdown *)
            bStateJustEntered := TRUE;
        END_IF;

    100: (* STATE 100: EMERGENCY_SHUTDOWN_DEPRESSURIZATION *)
        rSyngasH2TrimValve_pct    := 0.0; (* Immediate feed isolation *)
        rQuenchBed1Valve_pct      := 0.0;
        rQuenchBed2Valve_pct      := 0.0;
        rElectricPreheaterDuty_kW := 0.0;
        rCirculationCompSpeed_rpm := 1500.0; (* Coastdown sweep *)
        rChillerRefrigSpeed_rpm   := 0.0;
        rMembranePurgeValve_pct   := 100.0; (* Rapid depressurization to flare *)
        bSynthesisLoopTripActive  := TRUE;
END_CASE;

IF bStateJustEntered THEN
    bStateJustEntered := FALSE;
END_IF;

(* -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
(* STEP 11: COMPREHENSIVE ALARM TREE, DIAGNOSTICS & STATUS WORD ENCODINGS                            *)
(* -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
(* Safety Timers *)
tPressureHighHighTripTimer(IN := (rVotedLoopPressure_bar > 172.0), PT := T#1S);
tBed1TempHighHighTripTimer(IN := (rVotedBed1Temp_degC > 515.0), PT := T#500MS);
tStoichMismatchAlarmTimer(IN := (ABS(rFiltH2_N2_Ratio - 3.000) > 0.28), PT := T#15S);
tChillerFreezeAlarmTimer(IN := (rFiltCondenserTemp_degC < -32.0), PT := T#3S);

IF tPressureHighHighTripTimer.Q OR tBed1TempHighHighTripTimer.Q THEN
    bTripLatched := TRUE;
    bSynthesisLoopTripActive := TRUE;
    iOperationalState := 100;
END_IF;

(* Bitwise Packing: Alarm Word *)
wAlarmWord := 16#0000;
IF rVotedLoopPressure_bar > 162.0 THEN wAlarmWord := wAlarmWord OR 16#0001; END_IF; (* PAH: High Pressure *)
IF rVotedLoopPressure_bar > 172.0 THEN wAlarmWord := wAlarmWord OR 16#0002; END_IF; (* PAHH: High-High Trip *)
IF rVotedLoopPressure_bar < 85.0 AND (iOperationalState >= 40) THEN wAlarmWord := wAlarmWord OR 16#0004; END_IF; (* PALL: Low Pressure *)
IF rVotedBed1Temp_degC > 480.0 THEN wAlarmWord := wAlarmWord OR 16#0008; END_IF; (* TAH Bed 1 *)
IF rVotedBed1Temp_degC > 515.0 THEN wAlarmWord := wAlarmWord OR 16#0010; END_IF; (* TAHH Bed 1 Thermal Runaway *)
IF rFiltBed2Temp_degC > 470.0 THEN wAlarmWord := wAlarmWord OR 16#0020; END_IF;  (* TAH Bed 2 *)
IF rFiltBed3Temp_degC > 460.0 THEN wAlarmWord := wAlarmWord OR 16#0040; END_IF;  (* TAH Bed 3 *)
IF ABS(rBed1RateOfChange_degC_min) > 2.0 THEN wAlarmWord := wAlarmWord OR 16#0080; END_IF; (* Thermal Gradient High *)
IF tStoichMismatchAlarmTimer.Q THEN wAlarmWord := wAlarmWord OR 16#0100; END_IF;  (* Stoichiometry Mismatch *)
IF rFiltInertsFraction_pct > 13.5 THEN wAlarmWord := wAlarmWord OR 16#0200; END_IF; (* High Loop Inerts *)
IF tChillerFreezeAlarmTimer.Q THEN wAlarmWord := wAlarmWord OR 16#0400; END_IF;    (* Evaporator Freeze Risk *)
IF rFiltCondenserTemp_degC > 6.0 THEN wAlarmWord := wAlarmWord OR 16#0800; END_IF; (* Condenser Inefficiency *)
IF rMembranePartialPressDiff_bar > 120.0 THEN wAlarmWord := wAlarmWord OR 16#1000; END_IF; (* Membrane dP High *)
IF rDeltaTemp_Bed1_Bed2 > 40.0 THEN wAlarmWord := wAlarmWord OR 16#2000; END_IF; (* Inter-bed Delta T High *)
IF rCompressorSurgeMargin_pct < 12.0 THEN wAlarmWord := wAlarmWord OR 16#4000; END_IF; (* Compressor Surge Risk *)
IF bTripLatched THEN wAlarmWord := wAlarmWord OR 16#8000; END_IF;                  (* Master Trip Active *)

(* Bitwise Packing: Diagnostic Word *)
wDiagnosticWord := 16#0000;
IF NOT bPressureChA_Valid THEN wDiagnosticWord := wDiagnosticWord OR 16#0001; END_IF; (* PT-101A Discrepant *)
IF NOT bPressureChB_Valid THEN wDiagnosticWord := wDiagnosticWord OR 16#0002; END_IF; (* PT-101B Discrepant *)
IF NOT bPressureChC_Valid THEN wDiagnosticWord := wDiagnosticWord OR 16#0004; END_IF; (* PT-101C Discrepant *)
IF NOT bBed1TempChA_Valid THEN wDiagnosticWord := wDiagnosticWord OR 16#0008; END_IF; (* TE-201A Discrepant *)
IF NOT bBed1TempChB_Valid THEN wDiagnosticWord := wDiagnosticWord OR 16#0010; END_IF; (* TE-201B Discrepant *)
IF NOT bBed1TempChC_Valid THEN wDiagnosticWord := wDiagnosticWord OR 16#0020; END_IF; (* TE-201C Discrepant *)
IF iPressureValidSensorCount = 2 THEN wDiagnosticWord := wDiagnosticWord OR 16#0040; END_IF; (* PT Degraded 1oo2 *)
IF iPressureValidSensorCount = 1 THEN wDiagnosticWord := wDiagnosticWord OR 16#0080; END_IF; (* PT Degraded 1oo1 *)
IF iBed1TempValidSensorCount = 2 THEN wDiagnosticWord := wDiagnosticWord OR 16#0100; END_IF; (* TE Degraded 1oo2 *)
IF iBed1TempValidSensorCount = 1 THEN wDiagnosticWord := wDiagnosticWord OR 16#0200; END_IF; (* TE Degraded 1oo1 *)
